name: DC Hub
description: Live data layer for data-center site selection: daily Data Center Power Index (DCPI) scores of where data centers can get grid power across 300+ markets, plus grid, fiber, gas and interconnection-queue data, with a free tier that needs no key.

inputs.label: DC Hub API Key
inputs.description: Optional. The free tier works with no key; a DC Hub API key unlocks full reports and higher limits.

obtain.instructions:
1. Open dchub.cloud/connect
2. Request a free key with your email (or pick a plan)
3. Copy the key (starts with dchub_)

auth.instructions: Works without a key on the free tier. Add a DC Hub API key via the X-API-Key header for full reports; get one at dchub.cloud/connect.
